protocol.percentile: 100 * (average_rank - 0.5) / n finite heads; ties receive average rank
protocol.weights: equal categories, equal sources within category, equal pairs within source
protocol.sigma: weighted population SD of unique training endpoints; each pair weight split equally across endpoints
protocol.precision: float64 accumulation from cached float16 activations
protocol.class_rms_weights: category-conditional pair_weights: weights in each category sum to 1
protocol.patch_complete: A and P and C and F must all have exact effects in the same fold
protocol.patch_percentile: per category, within the 64 gradient-screened candidates before complete-case intersection
protocol.patch_raw_consensus: two-category means then mean across the same complete-coverage folds as percentile axes
protocol.incomplete_activation_cache: report coverage and leave fold activation axes missing; never impute or infer

patch_coverage.candidate_bias: gradient-screened candidate set; not an unbiased distribution over 1152 heads

score_interpretation: gradient attribution is a local first-order score-sensitivity proxy; cached exact patches measure intervention magnitude
